scripts.package: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/cli bundle && cd apps/cli && npm pack
scripts.standalone: bun run build && bun run --cwd apps/cli compile
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p packages/providers && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ingest && tsc --noEmit -p packages/scholar && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/verifier && tsc --noEmit -p apps/cli && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web
